title: Workplace Bullying: A Comparative Study of Depression and Suicidality Among Resident Doctors in Calabar and Land Brandenburg
summary:
The aim of this study is to compare the prevalence and association of workplace bullying with depressive disorders and suicidality among doctors in further training in Calabar and the state of Brandenburg.  Vis-a-vis. 
1. Determination of the prevalence of workplace bullying among Resident doctors in Calabar and the State of Brandenburg. 
2. Determination of the connection between bullying at work and depressive disorders among  Resident doctors  in Calabar and the State of Brandenburg. 
3. The connection between bullying at work and suicidality among Resident  doctors  in Calabar  and the State of Brandenburg should be examined
4. To compare the prevalence of workplace bullying among the resident doctors in Calabar and Land Brandenburg
conditions: Other symptoms and signs involving emotional state

interventions.name: The doctors in training at the centers will be contacted by email explaining the purpose of the study. They will be informed about data protection and consent to the study. Participation in the study is voluntary and involves anonymous data. The standardized questionnaires are made available to part

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Resident Doctors at the university hospitals in Calabar, Nigeria, and in the state of Brandenburg (Neuruppin, Bernau, Rüdersdorf, Brandenburg an der Havel).
2. Resident physicians who have been in training for at least 6 months.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Residents who refuse to consent to the study
2. Residents who are off rotation or on leave and cannot be contacted
